messages:
deploybot: Build pipeline started for release tag v2.7.1 on environment: staging-canary. Commit: abc1234. Pipeline: build -> lint -> unit-tests -> e2e. Change window: patch. Start: 10:23 PDT. link: https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/1234
ci-bot: build passed (runtime-image). duration: 4m12s.
ci-bot: lint failed — 8 problems in js/src/compile.ts: 'no-unused-vars', 'no-explicit-any'. First error: js/src/compile.ts:42:7 'logger' is defined but never used.
maya: @ash can you take the lint? quick patch preferred over pinning eslint.
ash: ash: on it, grabbing the top failures. looks like a stray import from the refactor. will push a tiny fix and rerun.
ben: if lint noise keeps happening we can pin eslint for the release, but i prefer small fixes.
ci-bot: unit-tests queued.
ci-bot: unit-tests passed.
ci-bot: e2e failed — smoke-suite/kv-integration timed out: 'Timeout waiting for KV initialize'. Full log: 
```
ERROR: Timeout waiting for KV initialize after 60s
at module.exports (/srv/tests/kv-setup.js:88:12)
```
olivia: hmm e2e timeout, could be infra flake. @oncall-bot any cluster events?
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: No recent node restarts in staging-canary. Monitoring shows a short spike in disk I/O at 10:22:45.
release-manager: hold canary until e2e triage completes. No rollback yet. Change window still open for 2h.
nash: pushed quick lint fix -> commit def4567 (branch: hotfix/compile-lint). Patch: removed unused import and adjusted types. Command: `git cherry-pick def4567`
deploybot: Triggered rerun for pipeline with commit def4567 (rerun-id: 1234-2).
ci-bot: rerun: build passed. lint passed. unit-tests passed. e2e queued.
ci-bot: e2e rerun passed — smoke-suite/kv-integration OK. duration: 2m30s.
maya: nice, looks green. thanks @ash. root cause?
ash: root cause: leftover import from refactor + a flakey KV startup race in the test harness. added a short init wait in test harness and removed the unused import. will open tracking ticket.
ben: recommend proceed with canary rollout to 5% and monitor for 30m. also add a one-line changelog entry about test harness fix and lint cleanups.
release-manager: agreed. I'll draft release notes: "runtime: test harness kv init flakiness fixed; minor lint cleanups". Will publish if canary stable.
olivia: @oncall-bot please apply latency and error rate monitors to the canary cluster for the next 60m.
oncall-bot: alerting policy applied for staging-canary. paging thresholds: 95th latency >200ms for 2m; error-rate >1% for 3m.
deploybot: Canary rollout started for v2.7.1 -> 5% traffic (deploy-1234). Tag: v2.7.1. link: https://deploys.redwood.example/deploys/1234
maya: adding note to release notes draft and changelog.
ben: :thumbsup: proceeding to monitor.
release-manager: will merge release notes and schedule wide rollout pending no regressions in 30m.
olivia: :eyes: watching metrics dashboard.
deploybot: Canary health: no alerts in first 10m. continuing monitor.
ben: if any regressions we roll back and pin binary to previous commit abc1222.
release-manager: copied decision to release log. closing thread when wide rollout starts.
